input-content-directory: inputs[0] has inline content, which can't be a DIRECTORY
input-http-directory: inputs[0] is a DIRECTORY with an HTTP(S) url; directories can't be downloaded over HTTP(S), list each file as a FILE input
input-s3-unconfigured: inputs[0].url is an s3:// URL, but this deployment has no S3 credentials; ask your administrator to configure S3 storage
input-without-url-or-content: inputs[0] must set url or content
output-s3-unconfigured: outputs[0].url is an s3:// URL, but this deployment has no S3 credentials; ask your administrator to configure S3 storage
